scope: Research-only public HTTPS GETs; no companion or installed-client test
body_retention: Raw bodies and media not committed; hashes and selected non-personal metadata retained

method.validation: JSON parsing; Pillow full image load; ffprobe and ffmpeg full audio/video decode; ZIP CRC plus image decoding
limitations: One representative medium per provider; other categories not tested
HTTP policy failures stopped without bypass
Initial Internet Archive search and metadata omitted model identifier; later requests corrected
Policy, copyright clearance and transport status are separate

requests.hypothesis: H01: The documented Commons Action API accepts an anonymous, serial search with a descriptive User-Agent and returns file/licence metadata.
H02: The Met documented anonymous search returns object IDs; image rights require an object lookup.
H03: AIC anonymous search accepts the public-domain filter and returns an IIIF image ID.
H04: CMA anonymous search returns a CC0 work and documented web/print image variants.
H05: The current Rijksmuseum Search API is keyless, unlike the retired collection API.
H06: LoC JSON search returns one public photograph result without authentication.
H07: NASA Image and Video Library search is anonymous and yields a video asset manifest.
H08: Internet Archive advanced search can return an audio item carrying a CC0 licence URL anonymously.
H02b: The replacement v1.1 documented in the 410 response and current official docs restores anonymous paginated search; this is a migration check, not a retry of the retired route.
H01d: The thumbnail returned by successful Commons search is a real image, not an HTML challenge; the returned work is CC BY-SA 3.0.
H04d: The successful CMA record marked CC0 resolves to a real web JPEG.
H05m: Resolving the result with the documented JSON-LD Accept header returns image representations and rights.
H09: LibriVox anonymous catalogue search returns chapter audio locations; its public-domain statement is US-specific.
H10: ccMixter Query API returns one instrumental licensed BY and a direct file link without login.
H11: Finna anonymous search returns an online image with per-image rights and download variants.
H12: Wellcome public image search returns IIIF locations and item-level licences without authentication.
H02m: The first search ID resolves to an object with an explicit isPublicDomain flag and image URLs.
H06d: The returned LoC record with no known publication restrictions delivers a real JPEG.
H07m: The NASA search asset manifest lists downloadable video renditions.
H08m: The returned Archive audio item exposes downloadable files and repeats its licence claim; uploader claims are not independent clearance.
H13: The documented ambientCG v3 filtered search returns a public CC0 material and download variants.
H14: PhyloPic taxon search follows the documented build redirect and returns a taxon list without a key.
H02d: The Met public-domain object delivers its documented web-sized JPEG.
H05d: The returned Rijksmuseum IIIF access point supports the documented resized JPEG request.
H07d: The NASA preview rendition is a complete MP4 below the 32 MiB test cap, not a still thumbnail or HTML. HTTPS is used for the returned asset host.
H08b: The first Archive CC0 result contained metadata only. A format-constrained community-audio search may return an actually downloadable file; no protected route is retried.
H15: Poly Haven documented search returns a public texture without a key; the client identifies itself and will retain live-service credit.
H09d: The returned LibriVox chapter resolves to a complete MP3; this validates delivery, not worldwide public-domain status.
H10d: The returned ccMixter CC BY 3.0 file is a decodable MP3; no client-ad licensing claim is made.
H16: SMK public OpenAPI search accepts an image/public-domain filter and returns one downloadable artwork.
H11d: The image marked PDM by the Finna record is retrievable from its contributing institution as real JPEG.
H17: BnF Gallica documented SRU permits an anonymous one-record image search; reuse eligibility remains separate.

headers.cache-control: private, max-age=0, no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, post-check=0, pre-check=0

requests.hypothesis: H08m2: The format-constrained Archive result exposes an audio file under the same licence claim.
H15m: The documented files endpoint lists a small public image rendition for the returned Poly Haven texture.
H12d: The Wellcome result marked PDM supports a standard IIIF JPEG derivative.
H14p: The returned build-pinned first-page link resolves the taxon needed to select its primary silhouette.
H13d: The returned 1K package is an actual ZIP containing usable texture images, not an interstitial.
H16d: SMK returns a real JPEG for the PDM-tagged search record through its advertised thumbnail URL.
H15d: The listed 1K diffuse asset can be downloaded anonymously and decoded as JPEG.
H08d: The smallest returned MP3 is publicly downloadable; this tests transport only, not the validity of the uploader CC0 claim.
H14m: The primary-image relation provides a licence and a supported raster download URL.
H14d: The API-selected silhouette is a real PNG and its per-image licence can be retained with the asset.
H43: SFXMint documented library search returns structured JSON without an account or key using an honest research User-Agent.
H44: The one API-returned SFXMint WAV downloads without credentials and is decodable audio matching the advertised hash.
